facts.fact: NIRA's playbook lists compliance with the Data Protection Act as a desired feature of the new national ID system.

UGA.note: Sovereignty goal is for the ID platform only; no rule or plan on state data.
Disability inclusion in recruitment and enrolment only; no digital accessibility measure.
74.9% against a population of 45.9 million is shown with the metric unlabelled.

facts.fact: NIRA says Uganda's new national ID system adopted open-source technologies on the MOSIP platform, seeking increased control and ownership of the identity platform technologies.

UGA.note: No register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: NIRA says it migrated 28.4 million records from the old system to the new MOSIP-based national ID system after an eight-month data preparation period.
